InstanceParameters.Name: Specification
InstanceParameters.Value: Two Piece, Press fit, Bronze body, Chrome plated brass ball, RTEF/TFE (250 Psig @ 250 Deg F)

TypeParameters.Name: Description
TypeParameters.Value: Altech Ball Valves AL 3601. Used for heating, cooling and air systems. With full bore and female thread, made of chrome-plated brass with steel handle, grafoil packing and chromium plated brass ball. May be used for Group 1 and 2 fluids (liquids and gases), according to AFS 2016: 1, the regulations for pressure equipment. Ball valves within the dimension DN40-DN50 are CE-marked according to PED 2014/68/EU.
